description: Na₆Sn₂Se₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Se atoms. There are two shorter (2.87 Å) and two longer (2.92 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.45 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.50 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SnSe₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent SnSe₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.18 Å. Sn is bonded to four Se atoms to form SnSe₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SnSe₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 22°. There are a spread of Sn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.57 Å. There are four inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Sn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Sn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-74°. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Sn atoms. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Sn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing SeNa₅Sn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-71°. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Sn atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Sn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-58°.
